title: The Urban Forest and Ecosystem Services: Impacts on Urban Water, Heat, and Pollution Cycles at the Tree, Street, and City Scale
tradition: 都市森林與生態系統服務

claims.claim_zh: 都市森林綜述依樹木、街道與城市尺度整理水、熱及污染循環；同一棵樹的效益會隨位置、冠幅、季節與維護改變。
claims.scope_zh: 跨地域城市森林研究；主張限於此來源的研究設計與樣本，不外推為本基地規範。

query.title: The Urban Forest and Ecosystem Services: Impacts on Urban Water, Heat, and Pollution Cycles at the Tree, Street, and City Scale
query.author: S. J. Livesley
